title: ReMCTS: Reflection-Enhanced Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.34717v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) can generate function-level programs from natural-language prompts, but plausible candidates still fail on hidden semantics and repeat mistakes across repair attempts. We present ReMCTS, an execution-grounded, memory-augmented, LLM-guided MCTS-style search framework. It organizes program candidates as tree states, retains branch-local debugging context, retrieves failure experience across branches, and distinguishes failed checks from unavailable evidence. On HumanEval and MBPP-Sanitized, visible-test ReMCTS improves over direct generation in 8 of 10 model-dataset pairs under held-out evaluation, whereas proxy-only search is less stable. Controlled tree-search, sampling, repair, and memory ablations characterize the source and limits of these gains. translated_title: ReMCTS：面向代码生成的反思增强蒙特卡洛树搜索
translated_abstract: 开放权重的大语言模型（LLM）能够根据自然语言提示生成函数级程序，但看似合理的候选程序仍会在隐含语义上出错，并在多次修复尝试中重复犯错。我们提出了ReMCTS，这是一个以执行结果为依据、具备记忆增强、由LLM引导的MCTS风格搜索框架。它将程序候选组织为树状态，保留分支局部的调试上下文，跨分支检索失败经验，并能够区分“检查失败”与“证据不可用”两种情况。在HumanEval和MBPP-Sanitized数据集的留出评估中，采用可见测试的ReMCTS在10个模型-数据集组合中的8个上优于直接生成，而仅依赖代理指标的搜索则稳定性较差。通过受控的树搜索、采样、修复和记忆消融实验，论文刻画了这些增益的来源与局限。一项包含30个任务的HumanEval-X C++试点实验进一步证明了该框架与编译器支持执行的兼容性，但这并不构成广泛的多语言评估（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: ReMCTS提出了一种以执行结果为依据、结合记忆增强与LLM引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索框架，通过保留分支调试上下文、跨分支检索失败经验并区分检查失败与证据缺失，显著提升了代码生成的准确性与修复效率。
en_tdlr: ReMCTS is an execution-grounded, memory-augmented, LLM-guided MCTS-style search framework that retains branch-local debugging context, retrieves cross-branch failure experience, and distinguishes failed checks from unavailable evidence to improve code generation.
